turns.query: Using the Federal Reserve supervisory stress test results, take the rows for the 2025 Stress Test under the Supervisory Severely Adverse scenario. Report how many rows there are and how many carry no institution identifier, then report how many named firms remain. On the named firms report the median starting common equity tier 1 ratio, the median minimum projected ratio and the median ending ratio, each in percent to 4 decimals, and report on how many firms the minimum ratio differs from the ending ratio. Explain what a higher ending ratio than minimum ratio means at the ratio level without attributing it to a particular capital or risk-weighted-asset mechanism.

Isolate the stress capital decline component used in the stress capital buffer calculation: the fall in the common equity tier 1 ratio from its starting level to the lowest level reached in the projection horizon. For the 22 named firms compute that decline and, as a comparison only, the decline from the starting ratio to the ending ratio. Report the median of each in percentage points to 4 decimals, the median of the first minus the second to 4 decimals, and the largest decline to the minimum to 4 decimals. Report how many firms have a minimum above their own starting ratio. Finally report how many firms have each decline at or below the 2.5 percentage-point minimum SCB benchmark. Explain the direction of the comparison, which decline the buffer calculation uses, and what these counts do not establish about firms' assigned buffers.

Check whether the comparison is particular to 2025. Restrict to the severely adverse scenario and to the four exercises named 2022 Stress Test, 2023 Stress Test, 2024 Stress Test and 2025 Stress Test, keeping only rows with an institution identifier. Report how many results those four hold in total, how many have a decline at or below the 2.5-point benchmark measured to the minimum, and how many measured to the ending ratio. Then, comparing the two counts within each exercise, report the name of the exercise where they diverge most and the size of that divergence in firms. State whether the direction of the count difference is consistent across exercises and note the panel-composition limitation.

Finally try to pair the 22 firms with their reported capital. Report how many of their institution identifiers appear as a filer identifier in the FFIEC Call Report capital schedule. Then look the same identifiers up in the FFIEC institution identifier file and report how many are found, how many carry the entity type for a financial holding company, how many the type for an intermediate holding company, and how many the type for a savings and loan holding company. Explain what the entity-type results imply about the legal-entity perimeter of this direct identifier match.
